# HAMi Helm Chart

<!-- Generated by helm-docs. Edit values.yaml and README.md.gotmpl. -->

Configure HAMi with a values file. See the user guide for instructions:

- [Installation](https://project-hami.io/docs/next/installation/online-installation)
- [Configuration](https://project-hami.io/docs/next/userguide/configure)
- [Upgrading and migrating values](https://project-hami.io/docs/next/installation/upgrade)

## Values

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|-----|------|---------|-------------|
| device-config.content | string | `""` | Complete device-config.yaml replacement, taking precedence over a bundled files/device-config.yaml and values. Non-empty content does not merge with the structured defaults. |
| devicePlugin.deviceListStrategy | string | `"envvar"` | NVIDIA device-list strategy passed through DEVICE_LIST_STRATEGY. |
